articles.title_en: The Macroeconomic Impact of Climate Change: Global Versus Local Temperature
articles.title_cn: 气候变化的宏观经济影响：全球温度与当地温度
articles.abstract_en: This article estimates that the macroeconomic damages from climate change are an order of magnitude larger than previously thought. Exploiting natural global temperature variability, we find that 1ºC warming reduces world GDP by over 20% in the long run. Global temperature correlates strongly with extreme climatic events, unlike country-level temperature used in previous work, explaining our larger estimate. We use this evidence to estimate damage functions in a neoclassical growth model. Business-as-usual warming implies a present welfare loss of more than 30%, and a social cost of carbon in excess of $1,200 per ton. These impacts suggest that unilateral decarbonization policy is cost-effective for large countries such as the United States.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估计，气候变化对宏观经济造成的损害比之前认为的要大一个数量级。利用全球自然温度变化，我们发现从长远来看，1°C 变暖会使世界 GDP 减少超过 20%。与之前工作中使用的国家级温度不同，全球温度与极端气候事件密切相关，这解释了我们更大的估计。我们利用这一证据来估计新古典增长模型中的损害函数。一切照旧的变暖意味着目前的福利损失超过30%，碳的社会成本超过每吨1,200美元。这些影响表明，单边脱碳政策对于美国等大国来说是具有成本效益的。

articles.title_en: A Theory of How Workers Keep up with Inflation
articles.title_cn: 工人如何应对通货膨胀的理论
articles.abstract_en: We develop a model that integrates modern theories of labor market flows with nominal wage rigidities to study the consequences of inflation on the labor market. Nominal wage stickiness incentivizes workers to engage in job-to-job transitions after an unexpected increase in the price level. Such dynamics lead to a rise in aggregate vacancies associating a seemingly tight labor market with lower real wages—two facts observed during the recent inflation period. The calibrated model jointly matches aggregate and cross-sectional trends in worker flows and wages during the 2021–2024 period. Using historical data, we show that prior periods of high inflation were also associated with increasing vacancies and upward shifts in the Beveridge curve. Our results suggest that policy makers and academics should be cautious about viewing the rise in the vacancy-to-unemployment rate as a sign of a tight labor market during inflationary periods without holistically looking at other labor market indicators.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个模型，将现代劳动力市场流动理论与名义工资刚性相结合，以研究通货膨胀对劳动力市场的影响。名义工资粘性会激励工人在物价水平意外上涨后进行工作转换。这种动态导致总职位空缺的增加，将看似紧张的劳动力市场与较低的实际工资联系起来——二在最近的通货膨胀时期观察到的事实。校准模型共同匹配2021-2024期间工人流动和工资的总体和横截面趋势。利用历史数据，我们发现先前的高通胀时期也与职位空缺增加和贝弗里奇曲线上移有关。我们的研究结果表明，政策制定者和学者应该谨慎对待，不要将空缺率与失业率的上升视为通胀时期劳动力市场紧张的迹象，而不全面考虑其他劳动力市场指标。

articles.abstract_en: We develop a system of disaggregated economic accounts. The system breaks down national accounting positions into bilateral flows between consistently defined groups of consumers (consumer cells), groups of producers (producer cells), the government, and the rest of the world. We disaggregate the full circular flow of money, including consumer spending, labor compensation, firm profits, intermediates trade, foreign trade, and government transactions, while satisfying all national accounting identities. We implement the disaggregated system for small region-by-industry cells in Denmark and present stylized facts, such as variation in domestic spending, local and urban bias in consumer spending, and a pattern of triangular flows across regions. Cell-level measures of spending intensity capture how much spending by a cell contributes to the income of cells experiencing unemployment after a shock. Using a general equilibrium model, we show that fiscal transfers raise aggregate GDP by more when they target cells with high spending intensity on unemployed cells. The disaggregated economic accounts help governments select more effective policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了分类经济账户体系。该系统将国民核算头寸分解为一致定义的消费者群体（消费者细胞）、生产者群体（生产者细胞）、政府和世界其他地区之间的双边流动。我们对货币的完整循环流动进行分类，包括消费者支出、劳动报酬、企业利润、中间品贸易、对外贸易和政府交易，同时满足所有国民核算恒等式。我们在丹麦按行业划分的小区域实施了分类系统，并提供了程式化的事实，例如国内支出的变化、消费者支出的地方和城市偏见以及跨区域的三角流动模式。支出强度的单元级衡量指标反映了单元的支出对冲击后经历失业的单元的收入做出了多少贡献。使用一般均衡模型，我们表明，当财政转移支付针对失业细胞的高支出强度的细胞时，可以使总 GDP 提高更多。分类经济账户有助于政府选择更有效的政策。

articles.abstract_en: Empirical studies find that the pass-through of input cost changes to prices is incomplete: a 10% increase in costs causes downstream prices to rise less than 10%, even at long horizons. Using microdata from gas stations, food products, and manufacturing industries, I find that incomplete pass-through in percentages often disguises complete pass-through in levels: a $1/unit increase in input costs leads to $1/unit higher downstream prices. Pass-through appears incomplete in percentages due to a gap between prices and costs. Complete pass-through in levels contrasts with workhorse macroeconomic models that feature homothetic industry demand systems. I identify an alternative class of demand systems that yields pass-through in levels and highlight four implications. First, measuring pass-through in percentages can lead to spurious evidence of asymmetry and size dependence. Second, pass-through in levels leads to systematic fluctuations in relative price and markup dispersion that are not associated with changes in allocative efficiency. Third, pass-through in levels can explain dynamics of industry gross margins, operating profits, and entry in the data that are at odds with workhorse models. Finally, incorporating pass-through in levels into an input-output model of the U.S. economy better matches the volatility of consumer price inflation and the response of inflation to identified shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 实证研究发现，投入成本变化对价格的传递是不完全的：成本的10%增加导致下游价格的涨幅低于10%，即使从长远来看也是如此。使用来自加油站、食品和制造业的微观数据，我发现不完全的百分比传递常常掩盖了完全的水平传递：投入成本每单位$1的增加导致下游价格上涨$1/单位。由于价格和成本之间的差距，转嫁百分比似乎不完整。水平上的完全传递与以拟似行业需求系统为特征的主力宏观经济模型形成鲜明对比。我确定了另一种需求系统，它产生级别传递并强调四影响。 第一，以百分比测量传递可能会导致不对称和尺寸依赖性的虚假证据。 第二，水平的传递导致相对价格和加价离散度的系统性波动，而这些波动与配置效率的变化无关。 第三，水平传递可以解释与主力模型不一致的行业毛利率、营业利润和数据条目的动态。最后，将水平传递纳入美国经济的投入产出模型可以更好地匹配消费者价格通胀的波动性以及通胀对已确定冲击的反应。

articles.title_en: Changing Opportunity: Sociological Mechanisms Underlying Growing Class Gaps and Shrinking Race Gaps in Economic Mobility
articles.title_cn: 不断变化的机会：经济流动性中阶级差距扩大和种族差距缩小的社会学机制
articles.abstract_en: We show that intergenerational mobility changed rapidly by race and class in recent decades in the United States and study the causal mechanisms underlying those changes. Between the 1978 and 1992 birth cohorts, earnings increased for white children from high-income families relative to white children from low-income families, increasing earnings gaps by parental income (class) by 30%. Earnings increased for Black children at all parental income levels, reducing white-Black earnings gaps for children from low-income families by 30%. Class gaps grew and race gaps shrank similarly for nonmonetary outcomes such as educational attainment, standardized test scores, and mortality rates. Using a quasi-experimental design, we show that the divergent trends in economic mobility were caused by differential changes in childhood environments, as proxied by parental employment rates, in local communities defined by race, class, and childhood county. Outcomes improve across birth cohorts for children who grow up in communities with increasing parental employment rates, with larger effects for children who move to such communities at younger ages. Children’s outcomes are most strongly related to the parental employment rates of peers they are more likely to interact with, such as those in their own birth cohort, suggesting that the relationship between children’s outcomes and parental employment rates is mediated by social interaction.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，近几十年来美国的代际流动性因种族和阶级而迅速变化，并研究了这些变化背后的因果机制。在1978和1992出生队列之间，相对于低收入家庭的白人儿童，高收入家庭的白人儿童的收入有所增加，父母收入（阶层）的收入差距扩大了30%。所有父母收入水平的黑人儿童的收入都有所增加，将低收入家庭儿童的白人与黑人收入差距缩小了30%。在教育程度、标准化考试成绩和死亡率等非货币结果上，阶级差距扩大，种族差距缩小。使用准实验设计，我们表明经济流动性的不同趋势是由童年环境的差异变化引起的，以父母就业率为代表，在由种族、阶级和童年县定义的当地社区中。对于在父母就业率不断提高的社区中长大的儿童来说，不同出生群体的结果都会有所改善，对于年龄较小时搬到此类社区的儿童来说，影响更大。儿童的成长结果与他们更有可能互动的同龄人（例如他们自己的出生队列中的同龄人）的父母就业率密切相关，这表明儿童的成长结果与父母就业率之间的关系是通过社会互动来调节的。

articles.title_en: Civil War–Induced Displacement and Human Capital
articles.title_cn: 内战引起的流离失所和人力资本
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of conflict-induced displacement on human capital and occupational shifts, focusing on the Mozambican civil war (1977–1992), during which millions of civilians were forced to flee to the countryside, cities, and neighboring countries. Reconstructing the wartime mobility histories of the surviving population, we examine the consequences of multiple displacement trajectories in a unified framework. First, we characterize the education and sectoral employment of the universe of (non-)displaced. Second, we exploit differences in relocation trajectories among extended kin members during their schooling years. Displacement is associated with significant gains in education. Third, using a movers design, we show that minors displaced earlier to better districts experienced an increase in educational attainment. Focusing on moves during the intensification of the war and when comparing members of the same household, regional childhood exposure effects remain strong, whereas spatial sorting becomes negligible. Fourth, we jointly estimate place-based, spatial sorting, and uprootedness effects, showing that all forces are at play. Fifth, a small survey in Mozambique’s largest northern city reveals long-term effects: internally displaced people report higher education than their siblings who stayed behind but lower social capital and worse mental health relative to locals. Our findings demonstrate that displacement shocks can foster human capital accumulation, even in very low-income settings, albeit at the cost of enduring social and psychological traumas.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究冲突引起的流离失所对人力资本和职业转变的影响，重点关注莫桑比克内战（1977-1992），在此期间数百万平民被迫逃往农村、城市和邻国。我们重建了幸存人口的战时流动历史，在统一的框架中研究了多种流离失所轨迹的后果。 第一，我们描述了（非）流离失所者的教育和部门就业情况。 第二，我们利用大亲属成员在就学期间搬迁轨迹的差异。流离失所与教育的显着进步相关。 第三，使用搬家者设计，我们表明，较早流离失所到更好地区的未成年人的教育程度有所提高。关注战争加剧期间的行动，并在比较同一家庭的成员时，区域童年暴露效应仍然很强，而空间排序则变得可以忽略不计。 第四，我们共同估计了基于地点、空间排序和连根拔起的影响，表明所有力量都在发挥作用。 第五，在莫桑比克最大的北部城市进行的一项小型调查揭示了长期影响：国内流离失所者的教育程度高于留守的兄弟姐妹，但与当地人相比，社会资本较低，心理健康状况较差。我们的研究结果表明，即使在收入非常低的环境中，流离失所冲击也可以促进人力资本积累，尽管代价是承受社会和心理创伤。

articles.title_en: Insuring Peace: Index-Based Livestock Insurance, Droughts, and Conflict
articles.title_cn: 确保和平：基于指数的牲畜保险、干旱和冲突
articles.abstract_en: We provide quasi-experimental evidence of how an innovative market-based solution using remote-sensing technology can mitigate drought-induced conflict. Droughts are a major driver of conflict in Africa, particularly between transhumant pastoralists and sedentary farmers. Index-Based Livestock Insurance (IBLI), a program piloted in Kenya, provides automated, preemptive payouts to pastoralists affected by droughts. Combining variation in rainfall and the staggered rollout of IBLI in Kenya over 2000–2020, we find that IBLI strongly reduces drought-induced conflict. Key mechanisms include a reduction in herd sizes, as well as income smoothing and asset price stabilization, contributing to an overall reduced migratory pressure for pastoralists. Our study suggests that market-based solutions are a scalable, cost-effective pathway to mitigate conflict, complementing political solutions such as power-sharing agreements and institutional reforms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了准实验证据，证明利用遥感技术的基于市场的创新解决方案如何能够缓解干旱引发的冲突。干旱是非洲冲突的一个主要驱动因素，特别是游牧牧民和定居农民之间的冲突。基于指数的牲畜保险（IBLI）是在肯尼亚试点的一项计划，为受干旱影响的牧民提供自动、先发制人的赔付。结合2000-2020肯尼亚降雨量的变化和 IBLI 的交错推出，我们发现 IBLI 极大地减少了干旱引发的冲突。主要机制包括减少畜群规模、收入平滑和资产价格稳定，从而总体上减轻牧民的迁徙压力。我们的研究表明，基于市场的解决方案是缓解冲突的可扩展且具有成本效益的途径，是对权力分享协议和机构改革等政治解决方案的补充。

articles.title_en: (Not) Thinking About the Future: Financial Information and Maternal Labor Supply
articles.title_cn: （不）思考未来：财务信息和孕产妇劳动力供应
articles.abstract_en: Does information about the long-run financial costs of reduced labor supply increase mothers’ working hours? We document descriptively that long-term financial factors are not top of mind when mothers decide on their employment level. Moreover, a substantial share of women holds overly optimistic expectations about pension receipt and wage growth under part-time work. In a large-scale field experiment in Switzerland, we randomly assign mothers working part-time as teachers to receive objective information about the long-run costs of reduced labor supply. The treatment increases both demand for financial information and future labor supply plans, in particular among women who underestimate the costs of part-time work. Leveraging linked employer administrative data one year post-intervention, we find that this group of mothers increases working hours by 7%. These findings underscore that policies reducing information frictions in labor supply decisions may help address remaining gender gaps in the labor market.
articles.abstract_cn: 有关劳动力供应减少的长期财务成本的信息是否会增加母亲的工作时间？我们描述性地证明，当母亲决定她们的就业水平时，长期财务因素并不是首要考虑的因素。此外，相当一部分女性对非全日制工作下的养老金领取和工资增长抱有过于乐观的预期。在瑞士的一项大规模实地实验中，我们随机分配兼职教师的母亲，以获得有关劳动力供应减少的长期成本的客观信息。这种待遇增加了对财务信息和未来劳动力供应计划的需求，特别是对于低估兼职工作成本的女性。利用干预后一年关联的雇主管理数据，我们发现这组母亲的工作时间增加了7%。这些发现强调，减少劳动力供应决策中的信息摩擦的政策可能有助于解决劳动力市场中剩余的性别差距。

articles.title_en: The Future in Mind: Aspirations and Long-Term Outcomes in Rural Ethiopia
articles.title_cn: 心中的未来：埃塞俄比亚农村地区的愿望和长期成果
articles.abstract_en: Aspirations may condition the future-oriented choices of individuals and thus may play a role in the persistence of poverty or the effort to break out of it. We run a randomized controlled trial in remote, rural Ethiopia to explore this and evaluate an intervention that aims to change how poor people perceive their future opportunities, alter their aspirations, and through that, modify their investment decisions. A treatment group was shown video documentaries featuring individuals from similar communities who escaped poverty through their own efforts and who serve as relatable role models. Five years after the screening took place, the treated households had increased future-oriented investments in agriculture, children’s education, and assets. The results can be explained by an increase in aspirations in terms of lifetime goals. Overall, this research uniquely provides evidence that a light-touch behavioural intervention can have persistent economic impacts on a poor population.
articles.abstract_cn: 愿望可能会影响个人面向未来的选择，因此可能会在贫困的持续存在或摆脱贫困的努力中发挥作用。我们在埃塞俄比亚偏远农村地区进行了一项随机对照试验，以探索这一问题并评估一项干预措施，该干预措施旨在改变穷人对未来机会的看法，改变他们的愿望，并通过这些改变他们的投资决策。向治疗组播放了一些视频纪录片，讲述了来自类似社区的个人通过自己的努力摆脱了贫困，并成为了相关的榜样。筛查进行五年后，接受治疗的家庭增加了对农业、儿童教育和资产的面向未来的投资。这一结果可以用终身目标的愿望增加来解释。总体而言，这项研究提供了独特的证据，表明轻微的行为干预可以对贫困人口产生持久的经济影响。

articles.title_en: Leveraging Virtual Contact and Social Networks to Foster Interethnic Harmony
articles.title_cn: 利用虚拟联系和社交网络促进种族间和谐
articles.abstract_en: This article investigates whether virtual contact, initiated through a documentary film, can promote interethnic harmony. We carried out a cluster-randomized field experiment involving over 3,300 households across 121 multiethnic villages in Bangladesh. We find that a documentary film, designed to humanize the ethnic-minority Santals and evoke empathy among the ethnic majority Bengalis, increased the ethnic majority’s prosociality toward minorities, though the strength of the evidence varies by treatment arm and outcome. Using emotion-detecting software to analyze facial expressions during the film viewing suggests that the documentary elicited emotional responses consistent with empathy. We do not find evidence that the intervention reduced the prevalence of negative stereotypes and discriminatory opinions toward minorities. In villages assigned to target network-central people, we find positive behavioral effects on untreated individuals, including Santals, and village-level administrative data suggest a reduction in police complaints in those villages. About five months after the intervention, we conducted a casual-work field experiment involving 720 participants from the main intervention. In this task, pairs of ethnic-majority and minority participants jointly produced paper bags for a local supplier under a piece-rate compensation scheme. We find positive treatment effects on productivity for both ethnic groups, with effects concentrated in villages where network-central people were treated. For the ethnic majority, increased prosociality, and for the ethnic minority, reciprocity or peer pressure may have contributed to increased productivity. Overall, our findings suggest that virtual contact and social networks may help promote harmony in multiethnic communities.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了通过纪录片发起的虚拟接触是否可以促进种族间的和谐。我们开展了一项整群随机实地实验，涉及孟加拉国 3,300 个多民族村庄的 121 多个家庭。我们发现，一部旨在使少数民族桑塔尔人人性化并唤起占多数的孟加拉人的同理心的纪录片增加了占多数的少数民族对少数民族的亲社会性，尽管证据的强度因治疗方式和结果而异。使用情绪检测软件分析观看电影期间的面部表情表明，这部纪录片引发了与同理心一致的情绪反应。我们没有发现证据表明干预措施减少了对少数群体的负面刻板印象和歧视性意见的流行。在指定为目标网络中心人员的村庄中，我们发现对未经治疗的个人（包括桑塔尔人）的积极行为影响，并且村级行政数据表明这些村庄的警察投诉有所减少。干预后大约五个月，我们进行了一项临时工作现场实验，涉及主要干预的720名参与者。在这项任务中，少数族裔和少数族裔参与者在计件补偿计划下共同为当地供应商生产纸袋。我们发现治疗对两个族群的生产力都有积极的影响，这种影响集中在网络中心人群接受治疗的村庄。对于大多数种族来说，亲社会性的增强，而对于少数族裔来说，互惠或同伴压力可能有助于提高生产力。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明，虚拟接触和社交网络可能有助于促进多民族社区的和谐。

articles.title_en: Automation and Rent Dissipation: Implications for Wages, Inequality, and Productivity
articles.title_cn: 自动化和租金耗散：对工资、不平等和生产力的影响
articles.abstract_en: This article studies the effects of automation in a task-based economy in which some jobs pay workers rents—wages above workers' outside options. We show that automation targets high-rent tasks, dissipating rents, amplifying wage losses, and reducing within-group wage dispersion in exposed groups. This form of rent dissipation is inefficient and offsets the productivity gains from automation. Using U.S. data from 1980 to 2016, we find evidence of sizable rent dissipation and reduced within-group wage dispersion due to automation. Automation accounts for 52% of the increase in between-group inequality since 1980, with rent dissipation explaining one-fifth of this total. Our estimates imply that inefficient rent dissipation has offset 60%–90% of the productivity gains from automation over this period.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了自动化在以任务为基础的经济中的影响，在这种经济中，一些工作向工人支付租金——高于工人的外部选择的工资。我们表明，自动化针对高租金任务，消散租金，扩大工资损失，并减少暴露群体的内部工资差距。这种形式的租金耗散效率低下，并且抵消了自动化带来的生产力收益。使用从1980到2016的美国数据，我们发现了由于自动化而导致的大量租金耗散和集团内工资分散减少的证据。自52%以来，自动化导致群体间不平等增加1980，而租金耗散则解释了这一总数的一-第五。我们的估计表明，低效的租金耗散已经抵消了这一时期自动化带来的生产率收益的60%%90%。

articles.title_en: How Do You Identify a Good Manager?
articles.abstract_en: We introduce and validate a novel approach to identifying good managers. In a preregistered lab experiment, we causally identify managerial contributions by randomly assigning managers to teams and controlling for individual skill. We find that manager contributions are crucial for team success, and that people who self-select into management roles perform worse than randomly assigned managers. Managerial performance is strongly predicted by economic decision-making skill but not by demographic characteristics. Two validation studies support our experimental results. Participants who succeed in the lab receive more real-world promotions and, in a separate study of retail store managers, skill measures strongly predict store sales. A one standard deviation increase in manager quality increases annual per store sales by US$4.1 million (25% increase). Selecting managers on skills rather than demographic characteristics or the desire to lead could substantially improve organizational performance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入并验证了一种识别优秀管理者的新方法。在预先注册的实验室实验中，我们通过随机分配管理人员到团队并控制个人技能来因果地确定管理贡献。我们发现经理的贡献对于团队的成功至关重要，而自我选择担任管理角色的人的表现比随机分配的经理要差。管理绩效很大程度上取决于经济决策技能，而不是人口特征。 二验证研究支持我们的实验结果。在实验室中取得成功的参与者会获得更多现实世界的促销机会，并且在一项针对零售店经理的单独研究中，技能衡量指标可以强烈预测商店销售额。经理质量的 一 标准差提高会使每店年销售额增加 4.1 百万 美元（25% 增加）。根据技能而不是人口特征或领导愿望来选择管理者可以大大提高组织绩效。

articles.title_en: Monetary Policy and Sovereign Risk in Emerging Economies (NK-Default)
articles.title_cn: 新兴经济体的货币政策和主权风险（NK-默认）
articles.abstract_en: This article develops a New Keynesian model with sovereign default risk. Inflation is set by forward-looking firms, monetary policy is an interest rate rule, and the fiscal government borrows externally, long-term, with an option to default. In this framework, default risk creates inflation pressures through an expectations channel, and tight monetary policy disincentivizes fiscal overborrowing. The model sheds light on temporary inflation events in emerging-market data: short-lived spikes in inflation, spreads, and domestic policy rates. As spreads rise, firms increase their prices in expectation of higher future inflation and low consumption during default. Monetary policy tightens, which reduces inflation and helps bring spreads down by disciplining government borrowing. These monetary-fiscal interactions imply that delivering the flexible-prices allocation may not be optimal for monetary policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个具有主权违约风险的新凯恩斯主义模型。通货膨胀是由有远见的公司决定的，货币政策是利率规则，财政政府长期对外借款，并有违约选择权。在此框架下，违约风险通过预期渠道产生通胀压力，而紧缩的货币政策抑制了财政过度借贷。该模型揭示了新兴市场数据中的临时通胀事件：通胀、利差和国内政策利率的短暂飙升。随着利差上升，企业因预期未来通胀上升和违约期间消费低迷而提高价格。货币政策收紧，这会降低通货膨胀，并通过规范政府借贷来帮助降低利差。这些货币与财政的相互作用意味着，提供灵活的价格配置可能不是货币政策的最佳选择。

articles.title_en: Trust and Innovation Within the Firm: Evidence from Matched CEO-Firm Data
articles.title_cn: 公司内部的信任和创新：来自首席执行官与公司匹配数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: This article shows that a CEO’s trust enhances innovation within a firm, providing a novel micro-foundation for the well-known trust-growth relationship. I build a new matched CEO-firm-patent data set covering 5,753 CEOs in 3,598 U.S. public firms and 700,000 patents during 2000–2011. I exploit variation in generalized trust across CEO ethnic origins, inferred from their last names using deanonymized historical censuses. Following CEO turnovers, a one standard deviation increase in a CEO’s generalized trust is associated with 6% more future patents and 4%–6% higher average patent quality, driven entirely by higher-quality patents. Text analysis of employee reviews shows that the CEO’s trust enhances a firm’s trust culture. These results are consistent with insights from qualitative interviews suggesting that the CEO's trust and the firm’s trust culture encourage researchers to undertake high-risk explorative research and development. In addition, changes in the CEO’s bilateral trust toward inventors in different countries have comparable effects on inventors’ patenting, controlling for CEO and other fixed effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文表明，首席执行官的信任增强了公司内部的创新，为众所周知的信任增长关系提供了新颖的微观基础。我建立了一个新的匹配的首席执行官-公司-专利数据集，涵盖 5,753 美国上市公司的 3,598 位首席执行官和 700,000-2000 期间的 2011 项专利。我利用首席执行官种族血统之间普遍信任的差异，通过去匿名的历史人口普查从他们的姓氏推断出来。 CEO 更替后，CEO 普遍信任度的 一 标准差增加与 6% 更多的未来专利和 4%%6% 更高的平均专利质量相关，这完全是由更高质量的专利驱动的。对员工评价的文本分析表明，首席执行官的信任增强了公司的信任文化。这些结果与定性访谈的见解一致，表明首席执行官的信任和公司的信任文化鼓励研究人员进行高风险的探索性研究和开发。此外，在控制CEO和其他固定效应的情况下，CEO对不同国家发明人的双边信任的变化对发明人的专利申请具有类似的影响。

articles.title_en: Growth Experiences and Trust in Government
articles.title_cn: 成长经历和对政府的信任
articles.abstract_en: This article explores the relationship between economic growth and trust in government using variation in GDP growth experienced over a lifetime since birth. We assemble a newly harmonized global data set across 11 major opinion surveys, comprising 3.3 million respondents in 166 countries since 1990. Exploiting cohort-level variation, we find that people who have experienced higher GDP growth are more prone to trust their governments, with larger effects found in democracies. Higher-growth experiences are also associated with improved perceptions of government performance and living standards. We find no similar channel between growth experience and interpersonal trust. Second, more recent growth experiences appear to matter most for trust in government, with no detectable effect of growth experienced during one’s formative years, closer to birth, or before birth. Third, we find evidence of a “trust paradox” whereby average trust in government is lower in democracies than in autocracies. Our results are robust to a range of falsification exercises, robustness checks, and single-country evidence using the American National Election Studies and the Swiss Household Panel.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用自出生以来一生中经历的 GDP 增长变化来探讨经济增长与政府信任之间的关系。我们在 11 个主要民意调查中收集了一个新协调的全球数据集，其中包括自 3.3 以来 166 个国家的 1990 百万 受访者。利用队列水平的差异，我们发现经历过较高 GDP 增长的人更容易信任他们的政府，在民主国家中发现的影响更大。更高的增长经历也与人们对政府绩效和生活水平的看法改善有关。我们发现成长经历和人际信任之间没有类似的渠道。 第二，最近的成长经历似乎对政府的信任最重要，在一的成长时期、接近出生或出生之前经历的成长没有明显的影响。 第三，我们发现了“信任悖论”的证据，即民主国家对政府的平均信任度低于独裁国家。我们的结果对于使用美国国家选举研究和瑞士家庭小组进行的一系列证伪练习、稳健性检查和单一国家证据来说是稳健的。
